_: The DOS machines on this bridge. Copy to boxes.json and edit.
_absent: No boxes.json at all is fine and is the default: the bridge
_absent2: behaves exactly as it always did, talking to one machine.
_ids: A box id is 1-8 characters of a-z0-9. It rides in the TFTP
_ids2: resource name as job.<id>, so it must stay 8.3-safe.
_addr: "ip" is mandatory and must be unique. dosd cross-checks every
_periph: "capture" and "power" are OVERRIDES on capture.json and
_periph2: power.json, which stay the schema. {} means 'this box has it,
_periph3: with the shared settings'. Omitting the key, or null, means
_periph4: the box does not have one -- and doscap/dospower then REFUSE
_periph5: rather than quietly showing you the other machine's screen.
_expect: "expect" is checked against what the box measures as, once
_expect2: per boot. A mismatch is a loud warning, never a reroute.
